title: a task that regenerates a published page can record a green gate before its commit, and a journal row keeps every detail its writer passed
desiredOutcome: The pre-commit sweep compares published pages against a fresh render, and the comparison against what the commit carries runs where a commit exists (CI and verify.sh --release), so a task regenerating a page is gated green on correct work without an override; close-phase's phase.merged row carries its parent, and a detail key outside the journal's allow-list at any append site fails the build instead of being dropped.

tasks.title: the published-page check compares against a fresh render before the commit and against the commit only where one exists
tasks.description: F521 (quality-gates-internal PLAN.md). ra23's live arm (--selftest compares every published page against HEAD) sits in the pre-commit sweep, so a task that regenerates a page with the repo's own recipe is red by construction until its commit, and commit-task-work binds a commit to a green gate - P80.7, P80.15 and P80.20 went through --override-verdict. Keep the fresh-render comparison in the pre-commit sweep; move the vs-commit comparison to where a commit exists - the CLI run CI and verify.sh --release make - and state in CONTRIBUTING.md and verify.sh which set carries it. gate-parity.py must stay green (every description of the gate set agrees). Red-first: a fixture page that matches a fresh render and not HEAD makes the selftest red on the current code and green after; allow: a page matching neither a fresh render nor HEAD still fails the pre-commit sweep, and the vs-commit arm still fails on a page the commit does not carry.

add: tools/check-rendered-artifacts.py: repro that FAILS on current code - a regenerated page matching a fresh render but not HEAD turns the --selftest red

outcome.technical: arms_for/arm_verdict with --before-commit and --against-commit; selftest and verify.sh/--affected use the fresh-render arm; --release adds the HEAD arm; live ra23 removed; ra25-ra28, a10c
outcome.descriptive: A task that re-renders a published page is no longer red until its own commit; CI and release still check that the commit carries the page

tasks.title: a journal row keeps every detail its writer passed: phase.merged carries its parent, and an unlisted detail key at any append site fails the build
tasks.description: F522 (quality-gates-internal PLAN.md). close-phase builds phase.merged's details with parent, but _journal_io keeps only DETAILS_KEYS and drops the rest silently, so the trail row is {phaseId, branch} and bf6b pins that. Add parent to DETAILS_KEYS (COMPATIBILITY.md: adding a detail key is free; say so if the row shape is promised), update bf6b and the manifest-conventions.md phase.merged bullet (which now says the parent is only in the summary) together with the writer. Then the class: a case in test__journal_io.py walks every .py under hooks/ and scripts/ by AST and fails on a literal details key at a journal append site that DETAILS_KEYS does not hold, naming file:line - so the next writer that believes it recorded a field it did not goes red. Red-first: the merged row names its parent (fails now); the lint goes red on a planted unlisted key and on the current close-phase before parent is added; allow: rows whose keys are all listed are byte-identical.

add: plugins/audit/tests/test_close_phase.py: repro that FAILS on current code - the phase.merged row read back from the trail names no parent
